text:
olivia: Heads up — after rebasing feature/telemetry on main CI is red. e2e telemetry tests failing in telemetry-service on staging job. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/telemetry/4557 :frowning:
ci-bot: build failed — job telemetry-e2e (shard 3/4) — failed tests: test_telemetry_ingest::test_ingest_huge_payload, test_telemetry_ingest::test_retry_backoff. logs: https://ci.internal/logs/4557
olivia: failing trace snippet:
```
AssertionError: expected 200 but got 503
File tests/e2e/test_ingest.py:42
...
ConnectionError: timeout during POST /ingest
```
mike: did you rebase from latest main? there was a migration merged yesterday that touches telemetry DB setup.
olivia: yep rebased onto main yesterday evening. migrations applied locally fine.
sara: can you run the failing e2e locally with docker? `pytest tests/e2e/test_ingest.py::test_ingest_huge_payload -q -k telemetry` or `./dev/run_e2e.sh --service telemetry --subset failed` — helps narrow if it's infra vs test.
olivia: trying local now — running `./dev/run_e2e.sh --service telemetry --tag shard3` — will report
jonathan: quick thought — we've seen a flake where the test assumes a synchronous flush. Try bumping the wait in test from 100ms to 500ms as a quick probe.
kevin: also check for leftover ports from previous runs — race on ephemeral port allocation caused 503s before.
olivia: local run reproduces one of the failures, stack:
```
requests.exceptions.ConnectionError: ('Connection aborted.', ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer'))
```
mike: can you git bisect between commit ab12c3 (before rebase) and HEAD? if it's a test regression, bisect should surface offending commit.
olivia: I don't have cycles to bisect today — can someone else pick it up? tagging @sara @mike
sara: can do. can you paste the last good main commit sha you rebased onto?
olivia: last good main sha was `a7f9d2b`
sara: ok kicking off `git bisect` on my laptop. will report back in ~30m.
ci-bot: rerun requested by @olivia — telemetry-e2e shard 3 queued (build 4558) <https://ci.internal/redwood/telemetry/4558>
olivia: thanks, please also try rerunning with env var `TELEMETRY_FORCE_SYNC=1` to see if it's a timing issue.
sara: bisect found the first bad commit: `d3c4e7b` — changes to telemetry ingestion backoff logic. opening quick PR to revert the change in test harness and add a regression test.
mike: nice. cc @jonathan please review — the change looks like it reduced retry windows too aggressively.
jonathan: on it. also add a comment about the DB migration order to avoid recurrence.
olivia: cheers — created PR #1428 with revert and extra wait. rerunning CI on PR.
ci-bot: build for PR #1428 started — telemetry-e2e all shards queued.
kevin: :thumbsup:
olivia: will follow up once green. thanks team.
